description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Free' shipping extension controller in the OpenCart admin interface. It defines methods for displaying and saving shipping configuration settings.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Controller class for managing the free shipping extension in OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping free configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language, model data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping free configuration settings via AJAX, including permission check, saving settings, and returning JSON response.
